examples.label: Icon break between two article sections
examples.source:
We rebuilt the page editor from scratch this spring. Every block you drop on the canvas is now rendered by the server, which means the preview you are looking at is exactly the markup your visitors receive.

<.component component_name="chelekom-divider" site="Global" size="small" color="silver"> <:icon name="hero-sparkles" />

The next release moves that same pipeline behind reusable sections, so a change to a shared header rolls out to every page that uses it without a single copy and paste.
